description: IIT 4.0 qualitative postulates as claims. Tier 3 axioms to be placed relative to Tier 1 and 2.

claims.statement: A system has causal power on itself
claims.plain: To be is to have cause-effect power

claims.statement: That causal power exists from the system's own perspective
The system specifies a particular cause-effect state
claims.plain: Consciousness is specific — it excludes alternatives

claims.statement: The system is irreducible — cannot partition without loss
One system, one level of description wins
claims.plain: Only the maximum φ system is conscious

claims.statement: Systems compose; higher systems can have their own φ
